# partiteai_route (Data Source)

Finds a route by its ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the route.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the route.
- `mesh_id` (String) The ID of the mesh.
- `name` (String) The name of the route.
- `segments` (Attributes Set) The shares of the traffic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--segments))

<a id="nestedatt--segments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `segments`

Read-Only:

- `mesh_version_id` (String) The ID of the mesh version that gets this share of the traffic. If it is null, the share goes to the mesh's draft.
- `weight` (Number) The share of the traffic, as a percentage.
